description: Fetches a public product feed (XML RSS/Atom, CSV, TSV, JSONL) and checks it against the OpenAI Commerce products feed spec (required: item_id, title, description, url, brand, seller_name, image_url, availability, price; plus GTIN check digit, sale_price, placeholders). Returns % SKUs OK, issue counts and sample issues.

feed_url.description: URL público http(s). (Caminhos locais só com SHOPAIREADY_ALLOW_LOCAL=1, para demo/testes.)

seller_name.description: Opcional: nome da loja para sugerir em seller_name em falta.

name: validate_feed_for_chatgpt
title: Validate feed for ChatGPT shopping
